title: The Need for a Socially-Grounded Persona Framework for User Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating 'demographic accentuation' (Bias%) by comparing the correlation between demographic similarity and response similarity in AI-generated persona outputs against a human baseline, to detect if models collapse behavior into demographic stereotypes.

Measuring demographic response correlations and bias accentuation specifically within different racial groups (White, African American, Hispanic/Latino, Asian, American Indian/Alaska Native) to identify group-specific overdependencies and misrepresentation.
